message.content:
LiHua inquires about Emily's familiarity with The Lord of the Rings novels during a conversation in a group chat. This can be seen in the following transcript from an HBO discussion thread:

```
Time: 20260922_17:00
LiHua: Hey Emily! Just wondering, have you ever read The Lord of the Rings novels? I'm really curious about how they tie into the series "The Rings of Power!"
EmilyBurnett: I haven't read the novels yet, but I've seen the movies! I know they have a rich background and all the lore that could be super helpful for understanding "The Rings of Power." What are your thoughts on the series so far?
```

In this exchange, LiHua expresses curiosity about LiHua's knowledge of the novels, especially in relation to the television adaptation "The Rings of Power." Emily responds that she has seen the movies and is aware of the series' rich background, but has not read the novels herself. She shows interest in how the novels might enhance her understanding of the TV series.
